sections.description: A full web version of the noodled note-taking app. Markdown notes with rich editing, family sharing, PIN login, GitHub sync, Plaud voice import, and 50+ power tools. Install on any WordPress site.
sections.changelog:
1.1.139

  • Plaud voice sync now works on the web: paste your Plaud token in Settings → Noodled (Sync tab) and the Plaud button appears in the app to import your transcripts
  • Paste a table from Sheets, Excel, or markdown and it becomes a real, editable table — keeping each column's left/centre/right alignment
  • New: a quick welcome on first run that points out the + button, the “/” menu, search, and the ☰ menu, so the app's many tools feel approachable
  • Reliability: offline edits that clash with another device are never dropped, even when several conflict at once

1.1.138

  • Offline-first: open and read any recent note with no connection — recent and pinned notes are cached on your device and marked with a small green dot
  • Edits made offline now sync in the background the moment you reconnect, even if you've closed the app (on Chrome, Edge and Android; iPhone syncs the next time you open it)
  • Your offline edits are never silently overwritten: if a note changed on another device, you're asked which version to keep
  • On a shared device, your cached notes are wiped when you sign out or a different person signs in

1.1.137

  • Accessibility: the table-editing toolbar now appears for keyboard users too (it follows the cursor into a table) and announces its Alt+Shift+Arrow shortcuts to screen readers
  • More of the app is fully translatable (admin sync diagnostics and note-import fallbacks)

1.1.136

  • Numbered lists: type "1." then your text and press Enter, and the note auto-starts an ordered list that keeps counting (2., 3., …). Also in the slash (/) menu.

1.1.135

  • Admins can preview the public marketing site from the ☰ menu (Account → View marketing site), with a Back-to-app button to pop right back

1.1.134

  • New app icon: a steaming bowl of noodles, so noodled looks like itself on your home screen (with a proper maskable + Apple touch icon)
  • Better link-share preview: a real wide preview image and Open Graph tags, so pasting the noodled link somewhere shows a clean card instead of a tiny cropped icon
  • 15 new (and shuffled) demo notes on the landing page

1.1.133

  • Fixed: in pop-up dialogs on mobile, checkboxes (like the "Drop folder" toggle in Manage People) were stretched full-width and their labels got cut off

1.1.132

  • Fixed: uploaded images and files showed up blank when you were signed in as the WordPress admin (the private file link now carries the security token an image request needs). Magic-link members were unaffected.

1.1.131

  • Folders shared with you are now grouped under a collapsible "Others' Noodles" section in the sidebar, instead of mixing into your own notebooks (grouped per person when someone shares more than one)
  • Manage People is redesigned for mobile: each person is a card with clear Send PIN / Remove buttons and a Drop folder toggle, nothing overlaps or gets cut off
  • Pop-up dialogs no longer run off the screen edges on small phones

1.1.130

  • New Tasks view: every checklist item across all your notes in one place, grouped by Overdue / Today / Upcoming, checkable inline. Add a date like 📅 2026-06-10 to a task to schedule it
  • New Smart notebooks: saved searches in the sidebar (e.g. has:open tag:work modified:7d)
  • New Calendar: jump to any day's journal; dots mark days with notes
  • New Link graph: a visual map of your [[wiki-linked]] notes
  • Nested notebooks: drag-free folders, right-click a notebook → Move into…
  • Note embeds: type ![[Note Title]] to embed one note inside another
  • Richer notes: mermaid diagrams (```mermaid), math (```math), and callouts (> [!warning] …, > [!tip] …, collapsible with > [!note]-)
  • Audio memos: record a voice memo that attaches to the note and transcribes as you speak

1.1.129

  • Version history now saves on the server, so earlier versions and the visual diff survive reloads and sync across your devices
  • Tables can be edited from the keyboard: Alt+Shift+Arrow keys add or remove rows and columns from the cell you're in
  • Faster first load (the app script now loads deferred)
  • Security: GitHub sync details are no longer shown to non-admin members

1.1.128

  • New: note reminders — set a date and time on any note (Note menu → Remind me) and get a notification when it is due
  • New: table editing — add or remove rows and columns from a toolbar, and a fix so editing a note that contains a table no longer loses the table
  • New: version history now shows a visual diff of what changed since an earlier version, with one-click restore
  • New: sync conflicts now offer Keep both, so neither version is ever lost
  • New: Privacy and Terms pages now open from the landing-page footer
  • Accessibility: better login-screen contrast and screen-reader roles on the slash menu
  • Offline edits keep queueing and sync on reconnect

1.1.127

  • Security: hardened note rendering against stored XSS in markdown links/images
  • Security: attachment uploads now use a strict type allowlist with real content verification (blocks disguised scripts and .htaccess uploads)
  • Security: private file proxy sends safer headers and downloads unknown types
  • Security: landing-page upload now CSRF-protected
  • Fix: attachment gallery no longer disappears after editing actions
  • Fix: shared drop folders reuse the same notebook instead of duplicating
  • Fix: permanent delete and empty-trash now clean up attachment files
  • Fix: dictation no longer errors when a note closes mid-recording
  • Accessibility and mobile polish across the app, admin, and landing page
